first class = the more expensive, more comfortable seats
announcement = a spoken message over loudspeakers
waiting room = a room where you sit until a train or bus comes
left luggage = a place at a station where you can leave bags for a few hours
lost property = the office that keeps things people have lost
hotel = a building where you pay to sleep
hostel = cheap shared accommodation, often for young travellers
youth hostel = cheap rooms for young people, often in bunks
guest house = a small house that rents rooms to travellers
reception = the desk in a hotel where you check in
single room = a hotel room for one person
double room = a hotel room with one large bed for two people
twin room = a hotel room with two separate beds
check out = to pay and leave a hotel
fully booked = with no free rooms left
room service = food brought to your hotel room
air conditioning = a system that cools a room
sea view = a window that looks out over the sea
tourist = a person who visits a place for pleasure
tour guide = a person who shows visitors around a place
